sources.title: Djibouti E-Government: eVisa entry document and scope
sources.publisher: E-Government Portal / National Agency for State Information Systems, Republic of Djibouti
sources.officialityEvidence: The current E-Government portal identifies ANSIE as a public agency attached to the Presidency and says its administrative information is certified and validated by the relevant administrations.
sources.supportingExcerpt: L'eVisa est un document qui certifie que le titulaire est autorisé à entrer et séjourner en République de Djibouti.

sources.title: Djibouti Immigration: live eVisa platform
sources.officialityEvidence: The live gouv.dj platform identifies itself as the official Immigration Directorate eVisa website; the National Tourism Office and E-Government guidance link that same platform for electronic visa applications.
sources.supportingExcerpt: This is the official website of the immigration directorate of the Republic of Djibouti.

sources.title: National Tourist Office: entry formalities and eVisa link
sources.officialityEvidence: The national tourism guide is hosted on visitdjibouti.dj and directly links the gouv.dj Immigration eVisa site as the electronic visitor-visa channel.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Les visiteurs peuvent obtenir leur visa électronique (eVisa) en soumettant leur demande en ligne.

sources.title: Law No. 40/AN/19/8ème L: conditions for entry and stay of foreigners
sources.publisher: Official Journal of the Republic of Djibouti
sources.officialityEvidence: The Official Journal publishes the current 2019 entry-and-stay law. Articles 15 and 16 split consular and eVisa issuance by the country from which the applicant applies, while Article 51 expressly repeals the 2007 and 2010 regime previously cited here.
sources.supportingExcerpt: peuvent obtenir une pré autorisation de visa d’entrée de transit, de court séjour ou de long séjour par le biais du système électronique E-Visa.
